text.tspan: Contraceptive usage: modern methods vs. any methods 2024
Estimated share of women using contraceptive methods, among those aged 15–49 and married or in union. This
is compared between modern methods and any method (modern or traditional).

tspan.tspan: Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS), Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys (MICS), and UN Population Division, via World Bank
"Modern methods" include oral hormonal pills, the intra-uterine device (IUD), male or female condoms, injectables, the implant, female

text.tspan: and male sterilization, vaginal barrier methods, or emergency contraception. "Traditional methods" include fertility awareness based methods,
periodic abstinence, withdrawal, and other traditional methods. Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between
